blocking.quote: Choosing Open on a row makes one request to open that row's exact web address with the default browser.
blocking.why: No task, plugin, command, or injected dependency provides the OS open call. TRD says "Commands, exactly: list_bookmarks() takes no arguments" and feature tasks "add no Rust command of their own". Cargo.toml has no tauri-plugin crate and capabilities/default.json has only core:default. TASK-06 names no dependency for its factory, so its test cannot inject an opener.
blocking.fix: Name the mechanism in TASK-06: add an exact-version opener plugin to Cargo.toml, lib.rs, package.json, and an opener permission in capabilities/default.json, with the open function injected into the factory; or amend the TRD command list with one allowlisted open command owned by OWN-OPEN-BOOKMARK.

blocking.why: TASK-04 exposes only status, add, and filter hosts, so there is no "summary" slot for TASK-06 to mount into.
blocking.fix: Replace "summary" with the per-row slot that TASK-04 is changed to expose (see the TASK-04 item).

blocking.quote: Expose exactly these named slots in the shared files, no others
blocking.why: The only slots are status, add, and filter. No per-row slot exists, and nothing requires the list to call slots.row for each record, so the per-row Open button of FEAT-OPEN-BOOKMARK has no place to be built.
blocking.fix: Add a named row slot such as "row-actions" to TASK-04's exposed list and require the list render to call slots.row("row-actions", record) for every row.

blocking.quote: Typing "rust" shows only bookmarks whose title or a tag contains "rust" in any letter case.
blocking.why: TASK-07 lists ACC-SEARCH-BOOKMARKS-01..03 as its acceptance criteria, but its focused test covers only that its control writes query. TASK-04's prompt says the match rule is tested in TASK-04's test, and TASK-04's Acceptance IDs omit ACC-SEARCH. No test owned by OWN-SEARCH-BOOKMARKS checks the stated criteria.
blocking.fix: Give TASK-07's focused test the rendered-row assertions for the match, clear, and no-match cases, or move ACC-SEARCH-BOOKMARKS-01..03 to TASK-04 and remove them from TASK-07.

blocking.quote: failures go through the errors banner
blocking.why: The PRD and TRD say a launch-load failure shows in the list area ("the list area shows one message, \"Bookmarks could not be loaded\""). TASK-04 routes it to the banner, which is outside the list area, so the placement contradicts the PRD.
blocking.fix: Show the launch-load failure in the list area (the status slot) with its retry action, or amend the PRD and TRD to name the banner.

blocking.quote: the installed desktop entry is validated before the launch smoke
blocking.why: No command, task, or script step validates the desktop entry or verifies the AppImage before the launch smoke. scripts/package_linux.sh only builds, copies, and writes the desktop file, and TASK-08 does not list the script.
blocking.fix: Add scripts/package_linux.sh to TASK-08's modify list and add a concrete validation step for the installed desktop entry and the AppImage, run before the launch check.

polish.quote: Validation: create and update return AppError invalid
polish.why: "Store operations, exactly these and no others" conflicts with the update and delete wording that TASK-05 repeats ("after a delete, remove that id"). An agent could add update or delete commands.
polish.fix: Delete the update sentence and the TASK-05 and TASK-06 delete sentences; state that only read and create exist.

polish.quote: its test fixes the clock and compares the local parts
polish.why: TASK-04 takes no now dependency, and the list shows no date, so this clause does not apply to it and the agent has to guess.
polish.fix: Remove the clock and local-parts clause from TASK-04 and keep only the instants rule the same paragraph gives.

polish.quote: the form rejects an empty title or an empty web address and keeps the entered values
polish.why: No text is given for the validation message, and the kit's rule covers only failed writes. The agent must invent a string.
polish.fix: Add the exact validation message text for an empty title and for an empty web address to the PRD.

polish.why: The kit guidance names Edit, Delete, and Copy, which the packet excludes. The agent might build those controls.
polish.fix: Replace the example with a non-excluded command, such as Open with nothing selected.

polish.quote: (the filter area or the list region)
polish.why: "the list region" is not an exposed slot, and the either-or leaves the mount point to the agent.
polish.fix: Name one slot: the filter slot.

polish.quote: Cover direct features none and owned contracts CON-SECURITY-BOUNDARY, CON-PACKAGING-RELEASE, CON-PRESET-OPTIONS, CON-RUNTIME-WIRING.
polish.why: The packaging test covers only the wiring check. Nothing tests the security boundary (no bookmark data in logs or diagnostics), so CON-SECURITY-BOUNDARY has no proof.
polish.fix: Add a packaging_tests assertion that scans production sources for logging of bookmark fields, or name the check that proves the boundary.

polish.why: Keyboard operation, reduced motion, and visible focus are required, but no task or acceptance criterion tests them.
polish.fix: Add one accessibility assertion (keyboard activation and focus visibility of the Add and Open controls) to TASK-04 and TASK-05 tests.

polish.quote: the compiler never guesses an option
polish.why: No compiler or generation step exists in the packet, so this failure behavior cannot apply and misleads the agent.
polish.fix: Replace the sentence with a check that tauri.conf.json and scripts/package_linux.sh contain the two preset options.

review.verdict: Not buildable without guesswork. The Open Bookmark feature has no mechanism to open the browser, no injectable dependency, and no row slot to mount into, and the search and list-failure criteria are tested outside their owners. Fix the six blocking items before the agent starts; the polish items are cleanup.
